en: {rival}
{player}! I knew you'd come this way. I've been filling in the Pokédex for Dad all the way up from Slateport!
But how's your team doing? Let's see who's been training harder!
{rival}
Wow, you've got so much stronger! I'll have to catch up.
Here, take this. I don't really need it. It's an Itemfinder!
Use it and it beeps when something's buried close by. It even turns you to face the right way!
Right, I'm off to Mauville! See you around, {player}!
Edwin
A fine battle! Would you exchange numbers? I'll call when my collection grows.
Register Edwin in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Splendid. I'll tell you all about my newest finds!
A pity. My collection would have impressed you.
Benjamin
You're quick! Let's swap numbers and keep each other training.
Register Benjamin in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Great! I'll call you after my morning ride.
Fair enough. See you on the road!
Abigail
You've got real power! Can I have your number? I want to keep up with you.
Register Abigail in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Thanks! I'll let you know how my Magnemite is doing.
Oh well. I'll just have to catch up by myself!
Isabel
Plusle and Minun want to be your friends! Will you register me in your PokéNav?
Register Isabel in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Yay! I'll call with all their cutest news!
Aww. Plusle and Minun are pouting now.
